+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from .parser import _OptionParser
+from .parser import _ParsingState
+
+
+class ColonArgumentTerminator(_OptionParser):
+    """An option parser that uses ``::`` instead of ``--`` as the
+    marker that unconditionally ends option processing. ``--`` is
+    processed like any other option-prefixed argument.
+    """
+
+    def _process_args_for_options(self, state: _ParsingState) -> None:
+        while state.rargs:
+            arg = state.rargs.pop(0)
+            arglen = len(arg)
+            # Double colons always handled explicitly regardless of what
+            # prefixes are valid.
+            if arg == "::":
+                return
+            elif arg[:1] in self._opt_prefixes and arglen > 1:
+                self._process_opts(arg, state)
+            elif self.allow_interspersed_args:
+                state.largs.append(arg)
+            else:
+                state.rargs.insert(0, arg)
+                return
diff --git a/tests/test_colon_argument_terminator.py b/tests/test_colon_argument_terminator.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..643cba6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_colon_argument_terminator.py
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+import pytest
+
+import click
+from click.colon_argument_terminator import ColonArgumentTerminator
+
+
+def _make_parser():
+    ctx = click.Context(click.Command("test"))
+    parser = ColonArgumentTerminator(ctx)
+    parser.add_option(
+        click.Option(["-a"], is_flag=True),
+        ["-a"],
+        "a",
+        action="store_const",
+        const=True,
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(click.Argument(["rest"], nargs=-1), "rest", nargs=-1)
+    return parser
+
+
+def test_double_colon_ends_options():
+    opts, largs, order = _make_parser().parse_args(["x", "::", "-a", "y"])
+    assert "a" not in opts
+    assert opts["rest"] == ("x", "-a", "y")
+
+
+def test_options_before_double_colon():
+    opts, largs, order = _make_parser().parse_args(["-a", "::", "-a"])
+    assert opts["a"] is True
+    assert opts["rest"] == ("-a",)
+
+
+def test_double_dash_is_processed_as_option():
+    with pytest.raises(click.NoSuchOption):
+        _make_parser().parse_args(["--", "-a"])
notes:
Added ColonArgumentTerminator subclassing _OptionParser, overriding _process_args_for_options with an identical copy of the base loop that stops on "::" instead of "--" (so "--" goes through normal _process_opts); base method has no decorators or super() calls. Added tests in tests/test_colon_argument_terminator.py.
